import FreeCAD, Part, MeshPart

doc = FreeCAD.newDocument('Sketch2CADReference')
box = Part.makeBox(30.0, 30.0, 10.0)
cylinder = Part.makeCylinder(8.0, 20.0, FreeCAD.Vector(15, 15, 10))
model = box.fuse(cylinder)

Part.export([model], 'reference_model.step')
mesh = MeshPart.meshFromShape(Shape=model, LinearDeflection=0.01, AngularDeflection=0.1)
mesh.write('reference_model.stl')
mesh.write('reference_model.obj')

print('=== CAD VERIFICATION READOUT ===')
print(f'Calculated Volume: {model.Volume:.2f} mm3')
print(f'Bounding Box: {model.BoundBox}')
print(f'Geometry Valid: {model.isValid()}')
print('Exported reference_model.step, reference_model.stl, and reference_model.obj')
